Have Fun. Curb Your Car.
It’s easy to live a car-lite, or even car-free, lifestyle in Delaware!
Use your bicycle and these tips to start down the path to a healthier,
more efficient form of travel.
1. Find your home on the Delaware Bicycle Maps and draw a circle
with a one- or two-mile radius around it. Use a highlighter to mark
places inside the circle that you regularly visit.
2. Choose a familiar place and try bicycling rather than driving. See
if you can find a comfortable route and secure parking. Add a new
location every 1-2 weeks.
3. See if you can find a closer destination for errands that fall
outside your circle. By slowly increasing the number of bicycle trips
and incorporating transit or using a carshare program, you’ll be
living car-lite in no time!
(Adapted from www.BikeNow.org)
